description: Returns the page's text and heading outline. Use this first when the question is what the page says rather than what it looks like: it costs a fortieth of a screenshot and a model reads a paragraph far more reliably than a picture of one. Reach for a capture when the question is visual.

scope.description: "page" prefers the main content region; "viewport" is only what is on screen.

name: read_page
title: The page as text
